data.exact_reserve_text: The 2015 Property results benefited from a lack of major loss activity during the calendar year and favourable development which has resulted in releases from prior year reserves. US Casualty business has faced difficult market conditions for some years although technical rates on our portfolio remain favourable; Faraday's loss experience continues to be relatively benign. This book continues to perform very well and it has been possible again to release reserves from prior years.

prior_year_events.impact_description: favourable development which has resulted in releases from prior year reserves

named_events.loss_description: The Syndicate's most notable catastrophe event occurred in December when the UK experienced a series of storms for which reserves have been established.

data.standardized_narrative: The overall gross prior year development for Syndicate 435 in 2015 was a strengthening of GBP 49.77 million, calculated from the claims development triangle. This was primarily driven by adverse development on the 2013 underwriting year, partially offset by favourable development on the 2011 and 2012 underwriting years. However, the narrative highlights releases from prior year reserves for both Property and US Casualty business due to favourable development and benign claims experience. A notable event in the current year was a series of UK storms in December 2015.
raw_causal_phrases: favourable development which has resulted in releases from prior year reserves
possible again to release reserves from prior years

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: The overall prior year development figure is calculated from the gross claims development triangle, which indicates a strengthening. This contrasts with the narrative which highlights releases from prior year reserves for Property and US Casualty business. The '2010 and prior' aggregate column was excluded from the prior year development calculation as per instructions.
